app.name: Sport Club Organizer
app.tagline: Plan seasons, teams, trainers and gyms — and generate a training schedule your club can rely on.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to manage your club.
auth.inviteOnly: Clubs are invitation-only. Ask an administrator for an invite.
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetLinkSentBody: If an account exists for that address, a password reset link is on its way. The link expires in one hour.
auth.newPasswordSubtitle: You'll be signed in once it's saved.
auth.signInFailedBody: We couldn't complete sign-in. Please try again.
auth.errorMissingCode: The sign-in link was incomplete. Please start again.
auth.errorExchangeFailed: That sign-in link has already been used or has expired.

invitation.signInAs: Sign in as {email} to join as {role}.
invitation.wrongAccountTitle: This invitation is for someone else
invitation.wrongAccountBody: It was sent to {invited}, but you're signed in as {current}. Sign out and sign back in with the invited address.
invitation.expiredBody: Ask a club administrator to send you a new one.
invitation.usedTitle: This invitation has already been used
invitation.usedBody: If it was you, just sign in. Otherwise ask for a new invitation.
invitation.revokedBody: A club administrator revoked it. Get in touch with them if that's unexpected.
invitation.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. Copy it from your email again, in full.

noAccess.title: You're not in a club yet
noAccess.body: You're signed in as {email}, but you don't belong to any club. Clubs are invitation-only — ask an administrator to invite this address, then open the link in the invitation email.

selectClub.title: Choose a club
selectClub.subtitle: You belong to more than one club. Pick one to continue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.setupBody: Seasons hold your teams, availability and schedules. Create one to get started.
dashboard.askOrganizer: Ask a club organizer to create the first season.

admin.title: System console
admin.systemAccessBody: You can read and administer every club here without being a member of any of them. Entering a club is written to that club's audit log, and the app shows a banner while you're inside one.
admin.noClubsBody: Create the first club to get started. You'll pick an Owner for it.
admin.createSubtitle: A club is a tenant — one organisation, with its own teams, athletes, gyms and schedules, isolated from every other.
admin.ownerEmailHint: Defaults to you. If this address has no account yet, one is created and you'll get an invitation link to pass on.
admin.timezoneHint: Recurring availability is interpreted in this timezone.
admin.invitedTitle: Club created — send the owner their link
admin.invitedBody: {email} had no account, so one was created and they were made Owner. Email delivery isn't wired up yet, so pass this link on yourself. It sets their password and expires.
admin.singleUseBody: This link signs them in once to choose a password. It won't be shown again — if it's lost, they can use “Forgot password” instead.

staffBanner.message: You're viewing {club} as a platform administrator. You aren't a member of this club, and this visit is in its audit log.

errors.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: You need to sign in to continue.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_ERROR: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.CONFLICT: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ERROR: An integration failed. Please try again.
errors.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: An external service is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.
errors.pageBody: We couldn't load this page. Try again — if it keeps happening, let your club administrator know.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
errors.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this
errors.forbiddenBody: Your role in this club doesn't include permission to view this page. An administrator can change that in Members.

list.noResultsBody: Nothing matched your search. Try a different term or clear the filters.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.subtitle: A season holds the teams, availability and schedules for one year.
seasons.name: Name
seasons.emptyBody: Create a season to start adding teams, availability and schedules.
seasons.onlyOneActive: Making this season active will archive the current active season.
seasons.duplicateBody: Copies teams, trainer and gym assignments, availability and training requirements into a new season. Schedules and past events are never copied.
seasons.archiveConfirmBody: Its teams and schedules are preserved and stay readable. You can't add new training to an archived season.

gyms.title: Gyms
gyms.subtitle: Where your teams train.
gyms.name: Name
gyms.sharesHall: Two teams can share this hall at the changeover
gyms.sharesHallHint: For a hall where one session can finish while the next warms up. The scheduler only uses it when a team cannot be placed any other way.
gyms.sportTypesHint: Which sports this hall can host. Used to narrow candidate gyms when scheduling.
gyms.emptyBody: Add the halls your club trains in. The scheduler needs at least one.
gyms.archiveConfirmBody: Past training sessions that used it are preserved. It won't be offered for new schedules.

trainers.title: Trainers
trainers.subtitle: Coaching staff and their availability.
trainers.emptyBody: Add your coaching staff. Each can then set the hours they're available.
trainers.archiveConfirmBody: Their past sessions are preserved. They won't be assigned to new training.
trainers.teamsRequired: Assign this trainer to at least one team.
trainers.teamsHint: A trainer with no team is skipped by the scheduler — it only offers a coach for teams they actually coach.
trainers.noTeamsYetBody: Trainers are assigned to teams, so there needs to be at least one before you can add coaching staff.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Squads for the selected season.
teams.name: Name
teams.emptyBody: Add the squads training this season.
teams.emptyNoSeasonBody: Teams belong to a season, so there needs to be one before you can add them.
teams.archiveConfirmBody: Its history and past schedules are preserved.
teams.noTrainingThisWeek: No training scheduled this week. Generate and publish a schedule in the Smart Organizer, or step through the weeks above.

athletes.title: Athletes
athletes.subtitle: Everyone who trains at the club.
athletes.emptyBody: Add the people who train at your club, then assign them to teams.
athletes.archiveConfirmBody: Their team history is preserved. They won't appear in new squads.

availability.title: Availability
availability.weeklySubtitle: The hours normally available, week after week.
availability.exceptionsSubtitle: Holidays, closures and one-off changes. These always win over the weekly pattern.
availability.validUntilHint: Leave empty for the rest of the season.
availability.emptyBody: Add the hours normally available each week. The scheduler can't place anything without them.
availability.overlapWarning: Overlapping hours on the same day are rejected — the scheduler can't act on contradictory availability.

requirements.title: Training requirements
requirements.subtitle: What this team needs from the schedule. Hard requirements must hold; preferences steer the result and can be traded away.
requirements.allowedWeekdaysHint: Leave all unticked to allow any day.
requirements.allowedGymsHint: Leave empty to allow any gym.
requirements.noSeason: This team's season is needed before requirements can be set.
requirements.priorityHint: When two teams want the same slot, the higher priority gets it. It never lets a team break a rule — it decides who is served first.
requirements.startsOnHint: Leave empty to start with the schedule. Sessions before this date are not created.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Training, matches and everything else the club has on.
calendar.allowsGymSharingHint: For in-house matches and tournaments. The scheduler never does this on its own.
calendar.blocksSchedulingHint: Holidays and closures: the scheduler treats this time as unavailable.
calendar.cancelConfirmBody: It stays on the calendar marked as cancelled, so the history is preserved.
calendar.emptyBody: No training or events in this period.
calendar.noPublishedSchedule: No schedule has been published yet. Training will appear here once it is.
calendar.dragHint: Drag a session to move it. Conflicts are checked before it's saved.
calendar.deleteConfirmBody: It is removed for good. If the event is real but isn't happening, cancel it instead — that keeps it visible to everyone who was told about it.
calendar.cancelVsDelete: Cancelling keeps the event on the calendar, marked cancelled. Deleting removes it entirely.
calendar.trainingNotEditable: This training belongs to a published schedule. Change it in the Smart Organizer, or move it on the calendar.
calendar.cancelSessionConfirmBody: Only this date. It stays on the calendar marked cancelled, so nobody turns up to a locked door — the rest of the series is untouched.
calendar.trainingActions: This session repeats weekly. Cancel just this date, or the whole recurring event.
calendar.cancelSeriesConfirmTitle: Cancel every remaining session of this event?
calendar.cancelSeriesConfirmBody: This slot repeats weekly. Cancelling the event calls off this date and every one after it. Sessions already past are left alone, and you can restore the series afterwards.
calendar.seriesCancelled: {count, plural, one {# session cancelled} other {# sessions cancelled}}.
calendar.seriesRestored: {count, plural, one {# session restored} other {# sessions restored}}.
calendar.scheduleStartsOn: This schedule starts on {date}, so the days before it are empty. Later weeks show the full pattern.

conflicts.END_BEFORE_START: The session ends before it starts.
conflicts.DURATION_MISMATCH: This session is {actual} minutes, but the team's requirement is {expected}.
conflicts.OUTSIDE_GYM_HOURS: The gym isn't open for the whole session.
conflicts.OUTSIDE_TRAINER_HOURS: The trainer isn't available for the whole session.
conflicts.OUTSIDE_TEAM_HOURS: The team isn't available for the whole session.
conflicts.GYM_DOUBLE_BOOKED: The gym is already booked then{team, select, other { by {team}}}.
conflicts.GYM_SHARED: Sharing the hall with {teams, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}} for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} at the changeover.
conflicts.GYM_OVERLAP_TOO_LONG: Two teams may share this hall for {allowed, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} at most, and this would be {minutes}{team, select, other { — {team} is already in}}.
conflicts.GYM_AT_CAPACITY: This hall takes {allowed, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}} at once, and that would make {teams}.
conflicts.TRAINER_DOUBLE_BOOKED: The trainer is already booked then{team, select, other { with {team}}}.
conflicts.TEAM_DOUBLE_BOOKED: The team is already training then.
conflicts.OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_HOURS: This falls outside the hours the team is allowed to train.
conflicts.WEEKDAY_NOT_ALLOWED: The team can't train on this day.
conflicts.GYM_NOT_ALLOWED: This gym isn't one the team can use.
conflicts.NOT_PREFERRED_WEEKDAY: Not one of the team's preferred days.
conflicts.WEEKLY_CAPACITY: This team can only train on {usableDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} a week, but asks for {requested}. The days below never work.
conflicts.DAY_NO_TRAINER: {weekday}: {gym} is open {gymFrom}–{gymUntil}, but no coach assigned to this team is available.
conflicts.DAY_NO_OVERLAP: {weekday}: {gym} is open {gymFrom}–{gymUntil}, but {trainer} is only available {trainerFrom}–{trainerUntil}.
conflicts.DAY_TEAM_UNAVAILABLE: {weekday}: the team itself is marked unavailable.
conflicts.DAY_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: {weekday}: {gym} and {trainer} only overlap for {minutes} minutes — not enough for a full session.
conflicts.SUGGEST_GYM_HOURS: Give a hall opening hours on {weekday} — at least {minutes} minutes.
conflicts.SUGGEST_TRAINER_HOURS: Make {trainer} available {from}–{until} on {weekday}, while {gym} is open.
conflicts.SUGGEST_ASSIGN_TRAINER: Assign this team a coach who is free {from}–{until} on {weekday}, while {gym} is open.
conflicts.SUGGEST_EXTEND_WINDOW: Widen {gym} on {weekday}: it overlaps the coach for only {minutes} of the {needed} minutes needed.
conflicts.SUGGEST_MORE_CAPACITY: Every slot this team could use is already taken. Add hall hours, allow more weekdays for it, or lower its weekly sessions.

organizer.title: Smart Organizer
organizer.subtitle: Generate a training schedule from your teams, trainers, gyms and availability.
organizer.teamsHint: Leave empty to schedule every active team in the season.
organizer.gymsHint: Leave empty to use every active gym.
organizer.notReadyTeams: No teams in this season yet.
organizer.notReadyGyms: No gym has availability set. The scheduler can't place anything without it.
organizer.notReadyTrainers: No trainer has availability set. Sessions will be generated unstaffed.
organizer.noUnmet: Every team got the sessions it asked for.
organizer.publishConfirmBody: It replaces the currently published schedule for this season. The previous one is archived, not deleted.
organizer.discardConfirmBody: The draft and its proposed sessions are removed. Published schedules are unaffected.
organizer.conflictsBlockPublish: Resolve the conflicting sessions before publishing.
organizer.noSeasons: Create a season before generating a schedule.
organizer.NO_ELIGIBLE_GYM: No gym is available to this team.
organizer.NO_GYM_AVAILABILITY: None of the gyms have opening hours set.
organizer.NO_ASSIGNED_TRAINER: No trainer is assigned to this team.
organizer.NO_TRAINER_AVAILABILITY: The assigned trainers have no availability set.
organizer.SESSION_LONGER_THAN_WINDOW: The session is longer than the hours the team is allowed to train.
organizer.NO_OVERLAPPING_AVAILABILITY: The team, its trainers and the gyms are never free at the same time.
organizer.GYM_AVAILABILITY_NOT_IN_FORCE: The gyms have opening hours, but none of them apply to the week being scheduled — check the date they take effect from.
organizer.TRAINER_AVAILABILITY_NOT_IN_FORCE: The assigned trainers have availability, but none of it applies to the week being scheduled — check the date it takes effect from.
organizer.withdrawConfirmTitle: Take this schedule off the calendar?
organizer.withdrawConfirmBody: The club stops seeing these sessions. Nothing is destroyed — the schedule and its sessions are archived, and you can discard it afterwards if you want it gone for good.
organizer.discardHint: Withdraw a published schedule before discarding it.
organizer.previewDescription: This draft, week by week. Nothing here is on the club's calendar until you publish it.
organizer.previewEmptyWeek: No sessions in this week. Step forward or back to find the ones that were scheduled.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who can use this club, and what they can do.
members.inviteBody: They'll get a link that expires in 14 days. If they have no account yet, one is created for them.
members.inviteLinkTitle: Invitation created — send them the link
members.inviteLinkBody: Email delivery isn't wired up yet, so pass this on yourself. It expires in 14 days and can be used once.
members.accountCreated: An account was created for this address.
members.removeConfirmBody: They lose access to this club immediately. Their history — teams coached, sessions scheduled — is preserved.
members.permissionsBody: Roles set the defaults. An override grants or removes a single permission for this person only.
members.emptyBody: Invite the people who help run the club.
members.cannotEditHigher: You can't change someone with the same or higher access than your own.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, and when.
audit.emptyBody: Changes to teams, schedules, members and settings appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How this club works.
settings.timezoneHint: Recurring availability and generated schedules are interpreted in this timezone.
settings.onboardingBody: A few things to set up before generating your first schedule.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect the club to the services it already uses.
integrations.aiSubtitle: Bring your own key. The club is billed by the provider, not by us.
integrations.aiGuardrail: AI explains and drafts. It never decides whether a schedule is valid — that stays with the scheduling engine, and its findings are always shown alongside.
integrations.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. Shown only as the last four characters afterwards.
integrations.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key.
integrations.removeConfirmBody: The stored key is deleted. Anything using AI falls back to the next enabled provider, or stops working if there is none.
integrations.noProvidersBody: Add a key from Anthropic, Google or OpenAI to enable schedule explanations and drafting.
integrations.googleSubtitle: Publish the club's training to a Google calendar.
integrations.googleNotConfigured: Google Calendar isn't set up on this deployment.
integrations.googleNotConfiguredBody: An administrator needs to add GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET before clubs can connect.

mcp.title: MCP API keys
mcp.subtitle: Let an AI assistant work with this club through the same rules a person gets.
mcp.explainer: An MCP key acts as you. It can never do more than you can — its permissions are the overlap between your access and the scopes you give it, so demoting your account weakens every key you issued.
mcp.endpointHint: Point your MCP client here and send the key as a bearer token.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameHint: What this key is for, so you can tell them apart later.
mcp.scopesHint: Leave empty to inherit your read access. Generating and publishing schedules must be granted explicitly.
mcp.expiresHint: Days. Leave empty for no expiry.
mcp.createdBody: This is the only time it is shown. It is stored hashed and cannot be recovered — if you lose it, rotate the key.
mcp.revokeConfirmBody: Anything using it stops working on its next request. The key is kept as a record, not deleted, so the audit log still explains what it did.
mcp.rotated: Key rotated. Copy the new one.
mcp.noKeysBody: Create one to connect an AI assistant to this club.
